notes: The causal score, core account, exits, protected-winner trigger and five-percent isolated sleeve remain frozen.
I requires the stock's causal 20-session return minus its same-day industry mean to be non-negative at the add signal close; missing industry features fail closed.
IM applies the same industry-leadership confirmation and also requires the benchmark close to be above its causal prior-session MA200.
The zero industry-excess boundary is an economic neutral point. No threshold, size, market or exit parameter is searched.
All historical periods have already been observed; this diagnostic cannot admit or replace a live or paper strategy.
